d: Short, platinum white hair with a side-swept fringe. Pale blue eyes with a calm, serene expression. A youthful, adolescent face with a slender build. Wearing a white and gold tunic with a flowing white cape and a large, translucent light-blue circular veil behind, paired with dark navy blue stockings and black shoes. Accessories include a blue and gold headpiece with a golden halo, a gold star-shaped shoulder brooch, and a golden ornate staff topped with a blue orb.
